The `text` below is a placeholder. Replace it with the actual wording of
the section you are licensed to hold. Do not paraphrase from memory: the
whole point of this corpus is that the assistant quotes something real
Required: document, documentTitle, issuedBy, authority, kind,
jurisdiction, and at least one section with text.
Optional: year, edition, current (defaults true), url, copyright.
documentTitle: General Instruction of the Roman Missal
_authority_options: universal_law         — council, universal law, the liturgical books
conference_adaptation — bishops' conference text with recognitio (US GIRM)
conference_guidance   — conference guidance without force of law (Sing to the Lord)
diocesan_policy       — binding locally, subordinate to all of the above
local_practice        — parish custom, your own practice
_kind_options: law | rubric | instruction | guidance | catechesis | policy
_jurisdiction_help: 'universal', or a country/diocese code: 'US', 'US/Atlanta'. A US adaptation must not be quoted at someone abroad as universal law.
